name: llm_triage_ticket
description: Classifies a support message into one queue: billing, technical, account, sales or other, with a short reason. Use it to route or tag incoming requests. An example LLM tool (mode classify), disabled until an administrator enables it.

llm.system_prompt: billing: invoices, charges, refunds, payment. technical: errors, outages, bugs, the product not working. account: sign-in, password, profile, access. sales: pricing, plans, quotes, buying. other: anything else.
